description: Upload an encrypted blob for image DM attachments

main.description: Upload an encrypted blob to the blob store. The blob_id is client-generated (UUIDv4) and doubles as the idempotency key. Content-Type must be application/octet-stream. The blob bytes are opaque encrypted data — the server never sees plaintext.

blobId.description: The blob identifier (echoed from input query parameter)
Client-generated UUIDv4 blob identifier. Also used as the idempotency key.

errors.name: QuotaExceeded
errors.description: User's blob storage quota has been exceeded (500MB per user)

errors.name: InvalidBlobId
errors.description: blob_id is not a valid UUIDv4

errors.name: BlobIdConflict
errors.description: blob_id already exists for a different owner
